# RX Tracker NEXT v4.0.0-next.94

RX Records now includes **Stage Report**, a popup for reviewing stage dates
and elapsed days, with complete filtered CSV export.

- Select multiple stages and Current / Reached scopes, or All scopes/stages.
  Current is the default; selecting both scopes does not duplicate RX/stage entries.
- Use All dates or inclusive stage-date bounds. Results start oldest to newest,
  grouped by stage, with 50-row pages.
- Sort any column across the full result; Stage sorts group names. CSV retains
  the filters and order and includes RX/patient IDs, patient, clinic, driver,
  stage, stage date and elapsed calendar days.
- Current scope shows the current driver. Reached/both scopes show the stage
  snapshot subject to existing driver-history permissions. Export requires
  RX export permission.
- Popup colors use the website's standard light/dark surfaces and subtle borders.

The endpoints are read-only. New styles are scoped to this popup, and existing
page styles, RX workflow updates, imports and patient edits are unchanged.
The separate staging history/archive changes are not included.

Synthetic PostgreSQL regression covers stage scope, duplicate/retired tracking,
sorting, pagination, date bounds/DST, complete CSV and access restrictions.
User reviewed the feature in staging and development. No new migration or
execution of automatic data rewrites; next.93 upgrades require no schema changes.

## Installation and verification

Use the official checksummed ZIP through Project Control option **8**, then
**15**. Preserve the paired application/database rollback set; the guarded
updater verifies data fingerprints and preserves `.env`.

Require healthy service version **4.0.0-next.94**. Refresh RX Records, open
Stage Report, compare Current/Reached filters, reverse a column sort and export
CSV. Confirm the file includes all matching pages. Check light and dark themes.

For older installations affected by the next.78 recovery incident, use
UPDATE-EXISTING-SERVER.bat from this verified release extraction outside the
application, following docs/database/COMPILED_RELEASE_UPDATES.md. Validate that
older upgrade path on the affected test host before production rollout.
Publication alone does not install the update. Emergency paired rollback uses
Project Control option **16**.
